rules: Moderate Occultism, high Performance, high Charisma-based skills; high Cha; low Fortitude, moderate to high Will; low to moderate HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: spontaneous occult spellcasting as a bard of their level, composition spells, muse feats
